title: Laser capture microdissection \(LCM) and RNA isolation
protocol: Obtain tissue samples from 12 μm-thick frozen sections for RNA analysis.

Place hypothalamic nucleus or 50 captured GFP-positive or -negative cells onto a single CapSure HS LCM Cap using specified parameters: spot size = 7.5 μm; power = 50–80 mW; pulse duration = 50–1,000 ms.
Isolate total RNAs using PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit.
Treat isolated RNAs with DNase I.
